description: Source code for managing progress bars in the cgame module of Unvanquished, including functions to get progress for load, build timer, stamina, oxygen, poison, health, ammo, fuel, and download, as well as command lookup and evaluation.

classes.name: progressBarCmd_t
classes.description: Structure representing a progress bar command, including its name, associated function to get progress, and element type.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_GetLoadProgress
methods.description: Calculates overall load progress, considering navmesh loading or other loading fractions.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_GetBuildTimerProgress
methods.description: Calculates build timer progress based on player's build weapon and build state.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_GetStaminaProgress
methods.description: Returns player's stamina as a fraction of maximum stamina.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_GetPlayerOxygenProgress
methods.description: Calculates oxygen bar progress, including prediction for overwater recovery.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_GetPoisonProgress
methods.description: Returns poison effect progress based on boost status and timing.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_GetPlayerHealthProgress
methods.description: Returns player's health as a fraction of maximum health.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_GetPlayerAmmoProgress
methods.description: Returns player's current ammo as a fraction of max ammo, considering reloading state.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_FuelProgress
methods.description: Returns jetpack fuel level as a fraction of maximum fuel.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_DownloadProgress
methods.description: Returns current download progress based on client variables.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_ProgressBarValue
methods.description: Retrieves the progress value for a given progress bar command name.
